children: Overview
Sweden technology group's Q3 net sales rose 4% yr/yr, with 13% organic growth excl. currency
Adjusted EBITA grew 8% and margin improved to 20.0% from 19.3%
Company completed two UK acquisitions and repurchased SEK 550 mln in bonds
Outlook
Company sees sustained demand in all business areas going forward
Sdiptech says 2026 margins provide a representative picture of sustainable profitability levels
Company aims to focus on profitable growth, higher returns on capital and long-term value
Result Drivers
ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said all business areas saw positive organic growth in net sales and adjusted EBITA
ACQUISITIONS - Co said two UK acquisitions expanded offerings in Supply Chain & Transportation

SECTOR DEMAND - Co said Security & Safety profit growth was driven by increased security needs and regulatory requirements, Energy & Electrification saw demand from electrification and energy efficiency, and Water & Bioeconomy benefited from investments
